adhoc.title: Add a custom line

errors.pickBranch: Pick a branch from the switcher before issuing this sale.
errors.namesRequired: Cashier and salesperson names are required.

issued.title: Invoice issued
issued.body: The invoice was registered with EIRMS. What would you like to do next?

draft.title: Draft saved
draft.body: MoR was unreachable, so we saved the invoice as a draft. Sync it from the invoices page once EIRMS is back.
draft.explainer: The sale is recorded locally with provisional number #{{number}}. When MOR is reachable again, open it from the invoices page and press Sync now to register it. The final document number may shift to match MOR's sequence.

header.title: Invoice history
header.subtitle: Every invoice registered with MOR is persisted here. Click a row to see details, verify, or cancel.

invoices.search: Search by IRN, buyer, or amount…

drafts.explainer: Saved while MOR was unreachable. Sync each once it's back.

invoices.empty: No invoices yet. Head to New sale to register one.

cancel.title: Cancel invoice
cancel.body: Cancelling files an EIRMS /v1/cancel; the invoice is retained but marked CANCELLED. Provide a reason for the audit trail.

header.title: Receipts
header.subtitle: Sales + withholding receipts issued from this branch.

receipts.search: Search by RRN, buyer, or amount…

header.title: Inventory items
header.subtitle: Items you add here power the point-of-sale grid. Track stock to see on-hand levels, and create a new SKU on a price change to keep history.

inventory.search: Search by name, code, SKU or barcode…
inventory.empty: No items match. Try a broader search.

stockCell.negativeHint: A store is below zero — open Stock to see which, then do a stock take.

restock.title: Restock
restock.deltaRequired: Enter a non-zero amount (use - to remove).

form.description: Code and title are required. The rest sharpens the POS + shelf experience.
form.title: Title *
form.longDescriptionPlaceholder: Optional. Shown in the item details.
form.onHandNote: Use the row's "Stock" action to change on-hand.
form.saveAsNew: Save as new SKU (keeps history — supersedes this one)
form.priceRequired: Enter a unit price of 0 or more.
form.supersedeDifferent: Give the new SKU a different item code.

writeOff.title: Write off stock
writeOff.body: Remove units of "{{item}}" without a sale.
writeOff.notePlaceholder: What happened? Batch # or invoice ref if relevant.
writeOff.quantityRequired: Quantity must be greater than zero.
writeOff.noteRequired: Add a note describing what happened.

header.title: Stores
header.subtitle: Named locations inside each branch. Stock is tracked per store; the sale path draws from the store flagged as sales floor.

stores.empty: No stores yet. Every branch was seeded with a "Main" store; if that's missing here, run the inventory expansion migration.
stores.confirmDelete: Deactivate "{{name}}"? Existing stock on this store is refused as long as it's non-zero.

form.description: Stores are named locations inside a branch — front shelf, back room, cold storage. Stock is tracked per store; the sale path draws from whichever store is flagged as sales floor.
form.name: Name *
form.salesFloorHint: The POS sale path decrements from this store. Only one per branch should be flagged — turning it on here demotes the current holder in the same transaction.
form.codeInvalid: Code must be uppercase letters, digits, underscore or hyphen.
form.branchRequired: Pick the branch this store belongs to.

transfer.title: Move stock
transfer.body: Move units of "{{item}}" between stores in the same branch.
transfer.dialogSubtitle: Move a tracked item between two stores in the same branch.
transfer.searchItems: Search items by name, code, or SKU…
transfer.needSecondStore: This branch has only one active store — add another to transfer between them.
transfer.notePlaceholder: Optional — e.g. restocking the front shelf.
transfer.sameStoreError: Source and destination must be different.
transfer.quantityRequired: Quantity must be greater than zero.

stock.subtitle: What this store is holding right now. Available is on-hand minus units held by open POS carts.
stock.searchPlaceholder: Search by item code, description, SKU or barcode
stock.empty: No stock in this store yet. Record a purchase or transfer stock in.

header.title: Vendors
header.subtitle: Suppliers you procure from. Used on purchase records; not to be confused with the withholding-receipt "supplier" concept.

form.description: Suppliers you procure from — kept separate from the withholding "supplier" concept, which is the counterparty on an outgoing withhold receipt.
form.name: Name *

header.title: Purchases
header.subtitle: Goods-received records. Each purchase writes a RESTOCK ledger row per line, increments per-store stock, and updates the item's running average cost.

form.title: New purchase
form.description: Record a goods-received event — increments per-store stock, writes RESTOCK ledger rows, and recomputes each item's running average cost.
form.notePlaceholder: Optional — e.g. condition of the delivery.
form.lineCostPositive: Line {{n}}: unit cost must be 0 or more.

header.title: Harmonization codes
header.subtitle: HS codes and the excise rate that goes with each. Inventory items reference this list instead of typing a code and rate by hand.

harmonization.empty: No harmonization codes yet. Add one to make it selectable on inventory items.

stock.blocked: Out of stock at this branch — restock or transfer before selling.

movements.title: Stock movements
movements.subtitle: Every change to on-hand at {{branch}} — sales, restocks, transfers, write-offs and corrections.
movements.empty: No stock has moved yet at this branch.
